title: Single Fire Door
lead: Pintu kebakaran tunggal tahan api yang dirancang presisi untuk proteksi evakuasi darurat gedung.
lead_en: Single leaf fire-rated emergency exit door designed for building evacuation and compartmentalization.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Size 120 x 70 x 50 mm, thickness 2.0 mm C channel.
door_leaf: Made of 1.5 mm plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet), with overlap of 24 mm width around the door leaf. Insulation Rockwool/Mineral wool with density 100 kg/m³ and door thickness of 55 mm.
optional: Vision panel with wire glass thk. 6.8 mm.
finishing: Steel parts treated by phosphating as rust prevention and then painted with Primary Coat.

title: Double Fire Door
lead: Pintu kebakaran ganda dengan konstruksi astragal pengaman untuk akses koridor dan jalur evakuasi lebar.
lead_en: Double leaf fire protection door equipped with sealing astragal for wide escape routes and high-traffic corridors.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Size 120 x 70 x 50 mm, thickness 2.0 mm C channel.
door_leaf: Made of 1.5 mm plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet), with overlap of 24 mm width around the door leaf. Insulation Rockwool/Mineral wool with density 100 kg/m³ and door thickness of 55 mm. Double door construction using astragal and made of steel plate.
optional: Vision panel with wire glass thk. 6.8 mm.
finishing: Steel parts treated by phosphating as rust prevention and then painted with Primary Coat.

title: Steel Single Door (Standard)
lead: Pintu baja tunggal berprofil kokoh untuk ruang utilitas operasional dan perlindungan fasilitas heavy-duty.
lead_en: Standard robust single steel door for industrial utility rooms and heavy-duty operational access.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Size 120 x 70 x 50 mm, thickness 2.0 mm C channel.
door_leaf: Made of 1.2 mm plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet), with overlap of 24 mm width around the door leaf. Door leaf thickness is 45 mm.
optional: Vision panel with Clear glass thk. 6.0 mm. Grille/Louver made of steel plate 1.5 mm thickness.
finishing: Steel parts treated by phosphating as rust prevention and then painted with Primary Coat.

title: Steel Airtight & Acoustic Door
lead: Pintu rekayasa khusus dengan segel karet neoprene untuk kekedapan udara dan isolasi suara hingga 30 dB (STC=30).
lead_en: Specially engineered door featuring neoprene rubber seals for maximum airtightness and acoustic dampening up to 30 dB (STC=30).
door_frame: Made of steel sheet plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Size 120 x 70 x 50 mm, thickness 2.0 mm C channel. The door frame is equipped with neoprene rubber.
door_leaf: Made of 1.5 mm plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet), with overlap of 24 mm width around the door leaf. Door leaf thickness is 55 mm (Rockwool density 100 kg/m³ & mineral acoustic). Double door construction using astragal and made of steel plate. Acoustic Steel door can reduce sound up to 30 dB (STC=30).
optional: Vision panel with Clear glass thk. 6.0 mm.
finishing: Steel parts treated by phosphating as rust prevention and then painted with Primary Coat.

title: Steel Blast Door
lead: Pertahanan tingkat ekstrem. Dibangun dari plat masif 6.0 mm untuk menahan gelombang kejut dan tekanan ledakan berbahaya.
lead_en: Extreme-level defense. Constructed from solid 6.0 mm steel plating to withstand severe shockwaves and explosive blast overpressure.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet, outer size 150 x 70 x (2.0+3.0) mm.
door_leaf: Made of steel sheet 6.0 mm. Door leaf thickness is 55 mm.
optional: Heavy-duty blast hinge & high-security locking hardware (standard blast accessories).
finishing: Rust-preventive treated & industrial protective primary coat finish.

title: Steel Louver Door
lead: Sistem pintu berventilasi dengan kisi-kisi baja untuk sirkulasi udara optimal pada area gardu listrik dan mesin.
lead_en: Ventilated steel door system with stationary louvers for optimal air circulation in substations and mechanical rooms.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Size 100 x 50 mm, thickness 2.0 mm C channel.
door_leaf: Blade of Louver: Made of 1.5 mm plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet).
finishing: Steel parts treated by phosphating as rust prevention and then painted with Primary Coat.

title: Steel Radiation Door
lead: Perisai andal melawan sinar radiasi berbahaya. Dirancang menggunakan lapisan timbal (Pb) murni untuk instalasi fasilitas medis dan nuklir.
lead_en: Reliable shield against harmful radiation. Engineered with pure lead (Pb) lining for medical and nuclear facility installations.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet, outer size 150 x 70 x 2.0 mm coated by lead (Pb) 2-6 mm.
door_leaf: Made of steel sheet 1.5 mm, door thickness 55 mm. Doors should be rebated door, equipped with overlap 24 mm width around the door leaf. Internal lead (Pb) lining 2-6 mm for radiation shielding.
optional: Radiation shielding lead glass vision panel (Pb equivalent).
finishing: Phosphating rust prevention and painted with Primary Coat.

title: Steel Shaft Door
lead: Panel akses utilitas cerdas untuk instalasi ducting gedung bertingkat, mengamankan jalur pipa mekanikal dan kabel kelistrikan.
lead_en: Smart utility access panel designed for high-rise building ducts, securing mechanical piping and electrical cabling runs.
door_frame: Made of steel sheet plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Size 100 x 50 x 35 mm, thickness 2.0 mm C channel.
door_leaf: Made of 1.2 mm plate (Hot Rolled Steel Sheet). Door leaf thickness is 40 mm. Double door construction using astragal and made of steel plate (fitted with cup handle & security bolt).
optional: Custom master key / cylinder lock, access panel locks.
finishing: Steel parts treated by phosphating as rust prevention and then painted with Primary Coat.
